definitions.explanation: a person who tends to feel embarrassed or self-conscious easily

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{恥|は}ずかしがり⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{人前|ひとまえ}→人前：19380_hitomae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧だ。
examples.english: He's shy and doesn't like speaking in front of people.

examples.japanese: {恥|は}ずかしがりな⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{克服|こくふく}→克服：02805_kokufuku⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧。
